title: CoopGovern: A Governance Model for Interinstitutional Co-operation Platforms in Health
content: The complexity of public health challenges demands collaborative approaches that transcend institutional boundaries, especially within science, technology, and innovation in health (ST&amp;IH). Interinstitutional cooperation platforms governance (IICPG) often lacks structured models, core values, clear guidelines, and effective performance indicators, leading to fragmented efforts and reduced capacity for crisis response, as observed during the COVID-19 pandemic. This study proposes a flexible governance model, CoopGovern, which integrates essential principles, strategies, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor and evaluate interinstitutional cooperation (IIC) activities. CoopGovern addresses significant governance deficiencies by focusing on structural integrity, coordinated actions, and performance metrics, fostering resilience and adaptability within health systems to respond effectively to global health challenges. It enhances the sustainability of cooperative endeavors in ST&amp;IH by aligning policies and coordinating resources across institutions and stakeholders. The model promotes innovation and public value in health, presenting a dynamical framework that optimizes governance and maximizes the impact of IIC.
